notes.title: Космический боди-хоррор в дебютном трейлере Directive 8020 от создателей The Quarry — теперь без The Dark Pictures в названии
notes.notes: Студия Supermassive Games представила дебютный трейлер научно-фантастического хоррора Directive 8020, лишившегося подзаголовка The Dark Pictures. В центре сюжета игры окажется экипаж космического корабля "Кассиопея", который терпит крушение на планете Тау Кита f, где сталкивается со смертоносным с инопланетным организмом, способным менять форму.

notes.title: На Gamescom 2024 могут показать новый хоррор The Dark Pictures Anthology: Directive 8020 от создателей Until Dawn
notes.notes: Похоже, студия Supermassive Games планирует провести на выставке Gamescom 2024 презентацию следующей части серии интерактивных хорроров The Dark Pictures Anthology с подзаголовком Directive 8020.

notes.title: Инсайдер: Авторы Until Dawn и The Quarry создают новую игру во вселенной Dead by Daylight
notes.notes: Создатели интерактивных хорроров Until Dawn, антологии The Dark Pictures и The Quarry из студии Supermassive Games готовят в партнерстве с Behavior Interactive новый проект во вселенной асимметричного кооперативного хоррора Dead by Daylight. Согласно информации инсайдера dvveet, действие однопользовательской игры будет происходить за пределами царства Сущности, где игрокам представят новых персонажей.

notes.title: МТС запустила сервис по продаже ключей для Steam - ремейк Resident Evil 2 доступен за 656 рублей

notes.title: The Devil in Me available for pre-order now! 🪓
notes.notes:
[h3]Discover a new trailer for The Dark Pictures Anthology: The Devil in Me, building up the tension as the crew hasten through the dimly lit hotel corridors and make gruesome discoveries in their attempt to escape the traps set for them by their mysterious host.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=p6_hzXmQt3A;full][/previewyoutube]
You can now interact much more with the world around you and enjoy new exploration actions which enrich this experience. As players tread the detailed and creepy corridors of the murder hotel, they will be able to push and pull objects, as well as run, jump or climb to reach areas that would otherwise have been inaccessible.

We also added an inventory system, with each character having a number of tools at their disposal to aid them in their story such as a directional microphone, camera and camera flash, tie pin and reporters pencil, items that will prove very useful over the course of your playthrough. Some objects can even be altered, broken or given to other characters, and some can save a life, or even take it!

The Dark Pictures Anthology: The Devil in Me is set to release on November 18th, 2022.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567020/The_Dark_Pictures_Anthology_The_Devil_in_Me/

notes.title: Join us this Fall for a Grand Opening 🗝️
notes.notes:
Coming this fall, [b][i]The Devil in Me[/i][/b] opens its doors to a whole new cast and terrifying story. This trailer gives a short but disturbing tour of what’s to come for its unsuspecting cast. 

[previewyoutube=GGGUWXpiqfs;full][/previewyoutube]
The [b]Lonnit Entertainment TV crew[/b] receive a pressing and mysterious phone call from a man called [b]Granthem Du’Met[/b], with a promise of a tour around a faithful recreation of the [b]H. H. Holmes murder castle[/b], an idea that Lonnit Entertainment founder [b]Charlie Lonnit[/b] believes might just save his show. 

[b]Oscar nominee Jessie Buckley[/b] stars as a member of this ill-fated crew that visits this strange hotel location, a place that quickly turns into a [i][b]deadly trap[/b][/i] made by their disturbed host Granthem Du’Met. [b]Observed, isolated, and [i]manipulated [/i]like rats in a maze[/b], it soon becomes clear that the crew’s check-out is compromised, and they will have to make some [b]impossible choices that they might live to regret or just not live at all![/b]

[h3][b]Ready to book a room of your own and face the killer? Enter the hotel and please enjoy your stay![/b][/h3]
